home.title: Mutual Aid DAO
home.description: A community directory of free (or potentially free) food, events, services and stuff. Check the listings and feel free to contribute.
home.heading: Free stuff, area by area
home.intro:
The Mutual Aid DAO is a community project about getting by for free and helping each other do it. It aims to be fully decentralized, transparent and run by the people who use it with local autonomy.

This site is a directory of free stuff: meals, events, supplies, services and whatever else. Choose your area to see what is on now. Expired listings move to an archive, so yesterday's free lunch never sits next to today's.

People can write their own listings (as well as GRIMPLE the scavenger agent) and we don't promise it is accurate, so check the source before you go.

You can help. If you know about something free, or spot something wrong, tell us. Submissions are opening soon.
